_comment: How npm run bench:fit-check (engine/tests/fit_check.py) runs spec 002's AC8 with this node. The check reads this file and the node's manifest, so nothing else names the node or its runtime or repeats its figures. `scale` is the param the bench sizes so the node's own estimate is each share of the card's budget; `fixed` holds the others there; the two groups below are the params of the overrun, and of the overrun with ctx.fallbacks turned off.
